'''Simone Jeanet Kennedy-Doornbos''' ({{IPA|nl|siˈmoːnə ˈkɛnədi}}; {{nee|'''Doornbos'''}}; born 19 December 1970) is a Dutch [[politician]] of the [[Christian Union (Netherlands)|Christian Union]]. Raised in a [[Reformed Churches in the Netherlands (Liberated)|Reformed]] family in [['t Harde]], Kennedy studied [[medical biology]] at the [[University of Amsterdam]]. As a student, she ran for the [[municipal council (Netherlands)|municipal council]] of [[Amsterdam]] in 1991 as the [[lead candidate]] of the [[Reformed Political League]] (GPV) – a precursor of the Christian Union. She married historian [[James Kennedy (historian)|James Kennedy]] in 1994, and the couple moved to [[Iowa]] that same year.

Nine years later, when Kennedy went back to the Netherlands and settled in [[Amersfoort]], she became active in both local and national politics. She joined the Christian Union's permanent campaign as well as several committees and its [[think tank]] before being elected to the Dutch municipal council in 2006. She served four terms as a councilor, filling the positions of leader of the Christian Union's [[parliamentary group]] and vice chairman of the council. During the [[2015 European migrant crisis]], Kennedy spoke out against the living conditions of refugees in the Netherlands, and she played a central role in local volunteering for asylum seekers.

Kennedy also participated in several national elections between 2006 and 2019 but was never elected. She was appointed to the [[Senate (Netherlands)|Senate]] for five months in January 2023 after the death of [[Peter Ester]] and to the [[Provincial Council of Utrecht]] two months later.

== Early life ==
Kennedy was born in 1970 as Simone Doornbos in the [[Overijssel]] city of [[Kampen, Overijssel|Kampen]] as the oldest of five children. Her parents were [[Frisians]], and her father worked as an engineer. At two years old, she moved to the village of [['t Harde]], located across the border in [[Gelderland]].<ref name="nd1">{{Cite news |title = Zelf vreemdeling geweest |pages = 4–7 |trans-title = Been an alien herself |language = nl |newspaper = [[Nederlands Dagblad]] |last = Meijer |first = Hilbert |date = 11 June 2016 }}</ref><ref name="ter"/> Her family belonged to the [[Reformed Churches in the Netherlands (Liberated)|Reformed Church]], and Kennedy attended an elementary school of that denomination in [[Dronten]]. As a child, she did gymnastics, played volleyball, and she learned to play the piano.<ref name="ter"/><ref name="eo1">{{Cite episode |url = https://www.nporadio5.nl/podcasts/eoonderweg/30952/6-simone-kennedy-christenunie-amersfoort-fractievoorzitter |access-date = 25 March 2023 |title = #6 - Simone Kennedy. ChristenUnie Amersfoort fractievoorzitter. |trans-title = #6 - Simone Kennedy. Amersfoort Christian Union parliamentary group leader. |language = nl |date = 5 February 2018 |series = Het Ene Moment |network = [[NPO Radio 5]] }}</ref> She went to the Greijdanus Secondary School in [[Zwolle]], receiving her [[Voorbereidend wetenschappelijk onderwijs|VWO]] diploma in 1989.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.delpher.nl/nl/kranten/view?coll=ddd&identifier=ddd:010559078:mpeg21:a0141 |via = [[Delpher]] |newspaper = Nederlands Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 25 March 2023 |date = 15 June 1989 |page = 10 |title = Uitslag examens |trans-title = Exam results }}</ref>

Kennedy subsequently studied [[medical biology]] at the [[University of Amsterdam]] until her graduation in 1994.<ref name="nd2"/><ref name="nd3"/> While a student, she became politically active as a member of the [[Reformed Political League]] (GPV) – a precursor of the Christian Union. According to Kennedy, her interest in politics was minimal, but she joined the party in order to participate in a 1990 trip to the [[Soviet Union]] organized by the GPV's youth organization called the GPJC.<ref name="eo1"/> She later became chair of GPJC Amsterdam, and she presented the GPV's national campaign for the [[1994 Dutch general election|May 1994 general election]].<ref name="nd2"/><ref name="nd3"/> Kennedy ran for the Amsterdam Municipal Council in the March 1994 local elections as the GPV's [[lead candidate]]. Prior to this moment, the conservative party had never managed to win a council seat in Amsterdam. Kennedy conceded that she did not expect to be elected, but explained that the campaign allowed the party to be recognized.<ref name="nd3">{{Cite news |url = https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=ddd:010628871:mpeg21:a0076 |via = Delpher |access-date = 25 March 2023 |newspaper = Nederlands Dagblad |last = Ubels |first = Ruud |page = 3 |date = 16 February 1994 |title = Verkiezingen 1994 |language = nl |trans-title = 1994 elections }}</ref> The GPV received 0.6% of the vote – not enough to claim a seat.<ref name="dv1">{{Cite web |url = https://www.verkiezingsuitslagen.nl/verkiezingen/detail/GR19940302/628534 |title = Gemeenteraad - 2 maart 1994 |trans-title = Municipal council - 2 March 1994 |access-date = 25 March 2023 |language = nl |website = Databank Verkiezingsuitslagen |publisher = Dutch Electoral Council }}</ref>

== Personal life ==
In 1991, she met her husband, [[James Kennedy (historian)|James Carleton Kennedy]], as they were both attending the Tituskapel in Amsterdam.<ref name="nd1" /> James had been born in 1963 in [[Orange City, Iowa]], to an American father and a mother from [[Rotterdam]]. He was visiting the Netherlands on a [[Fulbright Program|Fulbright scholarship]] to write his dissertation about Dutch history.<ref>{{Citation |url = https://www.volkskrant.nl/nieuws-achtergrond/it-s-a-little-benauwd-in-here~be11f44e/ |website = [[de Volkskrant]] |title = 'It's a little benauwd in here' |language = nl |last = Van Walsum |first = Sander |date = 3 February 2015 |access-date = 25 March 2023 }}</ref><ref name="ad1">{{Cite news |title = 'Dit soort onderwijs is het mooiste wat er is' |trans-title = 'There is nothing more beautiful than this type of education' |newspaper = [[Algemeen Dagblad|AD]] Amersfoortse Courant |language = nl |date = 23 January 2016 |page = 13 |last = Romanillos |first = Laura }}</ref> The couple married on 9 August 1994 in the [[English Reformed Church, Amsterdam|English Reformed Church]], part of the Amsterdam [[Begijnhof, Amsterdam|Begijnhof]]. They spent four months in the Christian living community [[L'Abri]] in [[Eck en Wiel]] before moving to the United States in December.<ref name="nd1" /><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.delpher.nl/nl/kranten/view?coll=ddd&identifier=ddd:010628987:mpeg21:a0143 |title = Familieberichten |trans-title = Family messages |via = Delpher |access-date = 25 March 2023 |language = nl |date = 5 July 1994 |newspaper = Nederlands Dagblad }}</ref> They initially lived in [[Iowa City, Iowa|Iowa City]] where James was completing his dissertation titled ''Building New Babylon: Cultural Change in the Netherlands During the 1960s'' at the [[University of Iowa]]. A translated version by Kennedy was published in 1995.<ref name="eo1" /><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.rd.nl/artikel/354621-een-kerk-met-oog-voor-de-naaste |title = Een kerk met oog voor de naaste |trans-title = A church with an eye for the neighbor |language = nl |url-access = subscription |website = [[Reformatorisch Dagblad]] |access-date = 25 March 2023 |date = 28 May 2010 |last1 = Karels |first1 = Jan-Kees |last2 = Van der Knijff |first2 = Jaco }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/1996/02/24/de-elite-als-wegbereider-van-de-jaren-zestig-7300480-a734461 |url-access = subscription |website = [[NRC (newspaper)|NRC]] |access-date = 25 March 2023 |language = nl |date = 24 February 1996 |title = De elite als wegbereider van de jaren zestig |trans-title = The elite as the pioneer of the 1960s |last = Zijderveld |first = A.C. }}</ref> Unable to find a job in her field of study, Kennedy was employed by a [[women's shelter]] and did some secretarial work before setting up a travel agency called Eurotrail, organizing cycling trips in the Netherlands.<ref name="ter" /><ref name="eo1" /> Kennedy moved to [[Holland, Michigan]], – a city with a significant [[Dutch-American]] community – in 1997. She was also active as a translator for [[Hope College]]'s A. C. Van Raalte Institute.<ref>{{Cite web |url = https://hope.edu/offices/van-raalte-institute/history-institute.html |website = [[Hope College]] |title = History of the Van Raalte Institute |access-date = 25 March 2023 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url = https://anderetijden.nl/aflevering/420/Holland-Michigan |title = Holland Michigan |language = nl |access-date = 18 April 2023 |website = [[Andere Tijden]] |last1 = Bruins Slot |first1 = Rob |last2 = Jansen Hendriks |first2 = Gerda |date = 6 September 2005 }}</ref> Kennedy's daughter was born in 1996, and two sons were born in 1998 and 2000.<ref>{{Cite interview |last = Kennedy |first = Simone |title = Engel van Soesterberg |language = nl |trans-title = Angel of Soesterberg |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 13 |date = 17 February 2016 |interviewer = Marco Willemse }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url = https://www.blogger.com/profile/17693436845680871061 |website = [[Blogger (service)|Blogger]] |title = Simone Kennedy-Doornbos |language = nl |access-date = 25 March 2023 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |language = nl |title = 'Porno mag niet open en bloot op straat' |trans-title = 'Porn should not be allowed openly in the streets' |page = 5 |last = Bruinsma |first = Robin |date = 7 February 2007 |newspaper = AD Amersfoorste Courant }}</ref>

When James became a history professor at the [[Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam]] in 2003, the family returned to the Netherlands after spending nine years in the United States,<ref name="nd2" /> settling in [[Amersfoort]].<ref name="ad1" /> Throughout her political career, Kennedy kept organizing cycling trips for American tourists, operating under the name Hollandtrail.<ref>{{Cite interview |last = Kennedy |first = Simone |pages = 2–3 |date = 2 March 2018 |language = nl |title = 'Ik dacht: moet ik er niet mee stoppen?' |trans-title = 'I was thinking: Should I quit?' |interviewer = Artwin Kreekel |newspaper = AD Amersfoorste Courant }}</ref> She translated her husband's book called ''A Concise History of the Netherlands'' (2017).<ref name="nd1" /><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/meestal-vind-ik-nederland-een-aangenaam-land~bd227219/ |title = 'Meestal vind ik Nederland een aangenaam land' |website = [[Trouw]] |url-access = subscription |trans-title = 'I usually think the Netherlands is a pleasant country' |language = nl |access-date = 25 March 2023 |last = Welgraven |first = Co |date = 11 March 2017 }}</ref> Kennedy has remained a member of the Reformed Church, and her family has taken care of foster children.<ref name="nd2">{{Cite news |url = https://www.nd.nl/nieuws/nederland/615862/portret-simone-kennedy-zelf-vreemdeling-geweest |access-date = 25 March 2023 |title = Portret Simone Kennedy: zelf vreemdeling geweest |trans-title = Portrait Simone Kennedy: Been an alien herself |language = nl |newspaper = Nederlands Dagblad |last = Meijer |first = Hilbert |date = 11 June 2016 }}</ref><ref name="ad8">{{Cite news |title = Simone heeft huis altijd vol pleegkinderen en vluchtelingen |trans-title = Simone always has a house full of foster children and refugees |language = nl |date = 29 March 2022 |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |pages = 4–5 |last = Hardeman |first = Johan }}</ref>

== Amersfoort politics ==
=== Early career ===
Along with her religious life, Kennedy became active for the party in her new hometown of Amersfoort. She initially assisted its [[parliamentary group]] in the municipal council, and she participated in the [[2006 Dutch municipal elections|March 2006 municipal elections]] in which the Christian Union won three seats.<ref name="eo1"/><ref name="dv2">{{Cite web |url = https://www.verkiezingsuitslagen.nl/verkiezingen/detail/GR20060307/625469 |website = Databank Verkiezingsuitslagen |publisher = Dutch Electoral Council |language = nl |access-date = 26 March 2023 |title = Gemeenteraad - 7 maart 2006 |trans-title = Municipal council - 7 March 2006 }}</ref> Kennedy was not elected, but entered in the council on 18 April 2006, when Hans van Daalen vacated his seat to become an [[wethouder|alderman]] in the new [[municipal executive]].<ref>{{Cite web |url = https://amersfoort.christenunie.nl/page/421 |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20070731173900/http://amersfoort.christenunie.nl/page/421 |via = [[Wayback Machine]] |language = nl |access-date = 26 March 2023 |archive-date = 31 July 2007 |title = Geschiedenis |trans-title = History |website = [[Amersfoort]] [[Christian Union (Netherlands)|Christian Union]] }}</ref><ref name="ek1">{{Cite web |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20230326200936/https://www.eerstekamer.nl/persoon/drs_s_j_kennedy_doornbos |archive-date = 26 March 2023 |url-status = unfit |url = https://www.eerstekamer.nl/persoon/drs_s_j_kennedy_doornbos |website = [[Senate (Netherlands)|Senate]] |language = nl |access-date = 12 August 2023 |title = Drs. S.J. Kennedy-Doornbos (ChristenUnie) }}</ref> Kennedy became her party's spokesperson for urban management, education, housing, economy, culture, tourism, recreation, and sports.<ref>{{Cite web |archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20070731173314/http://amersfoort.christenunie.nl/page/420 |url = http://amersfoort.christenunie.nl/page/420 |archive-date = 31 July 2007 |via = Wayback Machine |language = nl |website = ChristenUnie Amersfoort |access-date = 26 March 2023 |title = Fractie |trans-title = Parliamentary group }}</ref>

[[File:Mondriaanhuis.JPG|thumb|alt=A historic urban house with a sign saying "Mondriaanhuis"|The [[Mondrian House|Mondriaan House]] in 2008]]
As a councilor, she opposed an artistic porn festival that was planned to be organized in the city in the spring of 2007. She argued that it should not be held in a public space such that people would not be unintentionally confronted with sexually explicit content.<ref>{{Cite news |title = ChristenUnie valt over kunstzinnig pornofestival |trans-title = Christian Union opposes artistic porn festival |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 3 |date = 29 November 2006 |last = Hoving |first = Richard |language = nl }}</ref> She co-filed a [[motion (parliamentary procedure)|motion]] to not designate the event as "cultural" in order to withhold subsidies. It did not receive support from a council majority, but the subsidies were not granted in the end for a late application.<ref>{{Cite news |title = Geen geld, wel vergunning voor pornofestival |trans-title = No money but a permit for porn festival |date = 14 February 2007 |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |language = nl |last = De Vries |first = Leo |page = 3 }}</ref> During her term, Kennedy also drew media attention for her knitting during council meetings. She told media outlets that she had transitioned from knitting below her desk to above it, responding to the positivity posed by the audience.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/breien-tijdens-de-vergadering~bbf8b397/ |website = Trouw |title = Breien tijdens de vergadering |url-access = subscription |trans-title = Knitting during the meeting |last = Jansen |first = Mariska |date = 5 December 2006 |language = nl |access-date = 26 March 2023 }}</ref> However, Kennedy announced in March 2007 that she would stop the practice to prevent leaving a disinterested impression.<ref>{{Cite news |title = Breiend CU-raadslid haakt af |trans-title = Knitting CU councilor quits |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 3 |date = 28 March 2007 }}</ref> In 2008, the [[Mondrian House|Mondriaan House]] and the cultural foundation Amersfoort in C planned a merger for financial troubles from the Mondriaan House. Kennedy was critical of the foundation's plans to replace the collection of abstract [[Constructivism (art)|constructivist]] and [[concrete art]] by works of local young artists. She argued in the council that the Mondriaan House should spend €160,000 (${{To USD round|160000|EUR|year=2008}} USD) in subsidies on the acquisition of a climate system such that it could exhibit abstract works of art on loan.<ref>{{Cite news |title = 'Amersfoort schrijft Mondriaanhuis af' |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |trans-title = 'Amersfoort is done with the Mondriaan House' |page = 2 |date = 8 July 2008 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 3 |date = 11 July 2008 |title = 'Museum gaat zonder krachtig ingrijpen failliet' |trans-title = 'Museum will go bankrupt without a forceful intervention' |language = nl }}</ref> After a private party offered money, a compromise was reached between Amersfoort in C and the Mondriaan House under which the abstract art would remain and the climate system would be purchased. Kennedy co-sponsored a motion to provide the municipal funding required to execute the plan.<ref>{{Cite news |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |language = nl |title = Compromis Mondriaanhuis |trans-title = Compromise Mondriaan House |date = 20 September 2008 |page = 3 |last = De Valk |first = Jeroen }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |language = nl |title = Geboortehuis kunstenaar krijgt museale status én airco - Amersfoort kiest voor culturele 'parels' |trans-title = Artist's birth house becomes a museum officially and receives air con – Amersfoort choose for cultural 'pearls' |page = 2 |date = 25 September 2008 |last = De Valk |first = Jeroen }}</ref>

Kennedy was [[2010 Dutch municipal elections|re-elected in March 2010]] as the Christian Union's second candidate behind Van Daalen while the party retained its three seats.<ref name="ad2">{{Cite news |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |language = nl |title = Wethouder ChristenUnie ook lijsttrekker |trans-title = Christian Union alderman also lead candidate |date = 5 November 2009 |page = 21 }}</ref><ref name="dv3">{{Cite web |url = https://www.verkiezingsuitslagen.nl/verkiezingen/detail/GR20100303/625462 |website = Databank Verkiezingsuitslagen |publisher = Dutch Electoral Council |language = nl |access-date = 26 March 2023 |title = Gemeenteraad - 3 maart 2010 |trans-title = Municipal council - 3 March 2010 }}</ref> Kennedy was chosen as the council's vice chairman, allowing her to preside over meetings in the absence of the mayor.<ref name="ad6">{{Cite news |title = CDA'er Van Koningsveld vice-voorzitter raad |trans-title = CDA member Van Koningsveld vice chair of the council |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |language = nl |page = 9 |date = 26 April 2018 }}</ref> The new [[governing coalition]] consisted of the [[VVD]], [[GroenLinks]], [[Democrats 66|D66]], the [[Christian Democratic Appeal|CDA]], and the local BPA party that stepped out in December. The Christian Union joined the remaining coalition parties seven weeks later after Kennedy had represented her party during the negotiations. She simultaneously succeeded Menno Tigelaar as the leader of the parliamentary group in the council, since Tigelaar joined the municipal executive.<ref>{{Cite news |title = CU schuift moeiteloos in college |trans-title = CU joins municipal executive effortlessly |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 2 |last = De Vries |first = Leo |date = 19 January 2011 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite interview |last = Kennedy |first = Simone |title = 'Het is echt heel eng wat allemaal op ons afkomt' |trans-title = 'It is really scary what we are dealing with' |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |date = 24 February 2014 |page = 2 |interviewer = Eric van der Velden }}</ref> As a coalition party, the Christian Union voted in favor of a round of spending cuts totaling €20 million (${{To USD round|20000000|EUR|year=2010}} USD). However, during the preceding budget talks, Kennedy complained about savings on basic services. Specifically, she highlighted the removal of swimming lessons from the primary school curriculum, the closings of several library locations and neighborhood centers, and the removal of transportation for disabled students {{convert|7|km|4=0|abbr=on}} from a school as painful.<ref>{{Cite news |title = ChristenUnie tegen afschaffen schoolzwemmen |trans-title = Christian Union against abolishing swimming lessons in school |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 3 |date = 2 November 2010 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title = Meer verzet tegen snoeien |trans-title = Increased opposition against cuts |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 1 |date = 10 May 2011 |last = De Vries |first = Leo }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title = Omstreden bezuinigingen in Amersfoort (20 miljoen) gaan door |trans-title = Controversial spending cuts in Amersfoort (20 million) are passed |newspaper = [[de Stentor]] |date = 6 June 2011 |language = nl }}</ref> The coalition fell again in December 2012 due to a conflict between the VVD and GroenLinks, and a new one was formed that excluded the Christian Union.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/college-amersfoort-gevallen-om-rondweg~b058c816/ |website = [[Het Parool]] |language = nl |access-date = 28 March 2023 |date = 4 December 2012 |title = College Amersfoort gevallen om rondweg |trans-title = Amersfoort municipal executive fallen because of ring road }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.rtvutrecht.nl/nieuws/1379825/groen-licht-voor-nieuw-stadsbestuur-amersfoort |website = [[RTV Utrecht]] |language = nl |access-date = 28 March 2023 |date = 12 February 2023 |title = Groen licht voor nieuw stadsbestuur Amersfoort |trans-title = Green light for new Amersfoort executive }}</ref>

Kennedy was the party's lead candidate in the [[2014 Dutch municipal elections|March 2014 municipal elections]] in which the Christian Union increased its seat count from three to five.<ref name="ad3">{{Cite news |title = ChristenUnie kiest Kennedy |trans-title = Christian Union chooses Kennedy |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |language = nl |date = 19 October 2013 |page = 21 }}</ref><ref name="dv4">{{Cite web |url = https://www.verkiezingsuitslagen.nl/verkiezingen/detail/GR20140319/625470 |publisher = Dutch Electoral Council |website = Databank Verkiezingsuitslagen |language = nl |access-date = 28 March 2023 |title = Gemeenteraad - 19 maart 2014 |trans-title = Municipal council - 19 March 2024 }}</ref> The party entered into a new governing coalition with the VVD, D66, and the [[Labour Party (Netherlands)|Labour Party]].<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.rtvutrecht.nl/nieuws/1546694/college-amersfoort-rond |website = RTV Utrecht |language = nl |access-date = 28 March 2023 |date = 17 April 2014 |title = College Amersfoort rond |trans-title = Amersfoort municipal executive formed }}</ref> Kennedy proposed to subsidize [[couples therapy]] for disadvantaged people, arguing that poverty and hardship resulting from divorces are costly to society.<ref>{{Cite news |title = CU bepleit subsidie therapie |trans-title = CU advocates subsidies for therapy |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 24 |date = 21 June 2014 }}</ref> The Christian Union also cooperated with three homeless shelters to connect homeless youth with families willing to take them into their home.<ref>{{Cite news |title = 'Zwerfjongere in huis' |trans-title = 'Homeless youth at home' |date = 23 December 2014 |last = Kreekel |first = Artwin |page = 1 |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant }}</ref> In 2017, a majority of the council voted in favor of a joint proposal by the party and the CDA to make it possible for troublemakers to be placed in a temporary house. However, some questions about its legality were later raised, as the measure would not be imposed by a judge.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.ad.nl/amersfoort/amersfoortse-politiek-introduceert-aso-woningen~a8d1c868/ |website = Algemeen Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 3 April 2023 |date = 10 October 2017 |last = Kreekel |first = Artwin |title = Amersfoortse politiek introduceert 'aso-woningen' |trans-title = Amersfoort politics introduces 'antisocial housing' }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.ad.nl/amersfoort/vragen-over-haalbaarheid-asowoningen-in-de-stad~afd6645e/ |last = Kreekel |first = Artwin |website = [[Algemeen Dagblad]] |language = nl |access-date = 3 April 2023 |date = 17 October 2017 |title = Vragen over haalbaarheid asowoningen in de stad |url-access = subscription |trans-title = Questions about feasibility of antisocial housing in the city }}</ref>

=== Refugee crisis ===
In 2015, Europe experienced an [[2015 European migrant crisis|increased number of migrants entering the continent]] – partly as a result of the [[Syrian civil war]]. In an opinion article, Kennedy proposed to convert empty office buildings, schools, and healthcare facilities into [[cohousing]] units for refugees to divert demand away from the real estate market. She suggested that they could also temporarily house students, divorced parents, and people early in their career.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/co-housing-biedt-ruimte-voor-vluchtelingen~b3f61c3d/ |url-access = subscription |website = Trouw |language = nl |access-date = 29 March 2023 |last1 = Kennedy-Doornbos |first1 = Simone |last2 = Wijmenga |first2 = Laurens |title = Co-housing biedt ruimte voor vluchtelingen |trans-title = Cohousing provides space for refugees |date = 4 September 2015 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title = Opvang in kantoren |date = 2 September 2015 |trans-title = Shelter in offices |newspaper = Amersfoort Nu |language = nl }}</ref> Some councilors criticized the plan, saying it would lead to clashes between different groups and ghettos in the city.<ref>{{Cite news |language = nl |title = Plan ChristenUnie voor cohousing oogst lof, maar ook kritiek |trans-title = Cohousing plan Christian Union receives praise but also criticism |date = 17 September 2015 |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 3 |last = De Vries |first = Leo }}</ref> The idea was later brought into practice at several locations.<ref name="ad8"/><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.ad.nl/amersfoort/heel-veel-flyeren-en-niet-aanbellen-corona-maakt-kiezers-winnen-moeilijk~a01b9be1/ |website = Algemeen Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 17 April 2023 |date = 6 March 2021 |last = Van Dijk |first = Piet |url-access = subscription |title = Heel veel flyeren en niet aanbellen: corona maakt kiezers winnen moeilijk |trans-title = Handing out a lot of flyers and not going from door to door: COVID-19 makes it hard to gain voters }}</ref> Kennedy herself had taken in a Syrian lesbian professor before the influx of refugees had started as suggested by her husband.<ref name="nd2"/><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.rtvutrecht.nl/nieuws/1378167/raadslid-amersfoort-vangt-syrische-vluchtelinge-op |website = RTV Utrecht |language = nl |access-date = 29 March 2023 |date = 4 September 2015 |title = Raadslid Amersfoort vangt Syrische vluchtelinge op |trans-title = Amersfoort councilor takes care of Syrian refugee }}</ref> She created a [[Facebook group]] called ''Gastgezin Amersfoort'' (Host family Amersfoort) in September 2015 for people interested in volunteering for or housing refugees.<ref>{{Cite news |title = Facebookgroep voor gastgezinnen |trans-title = Facebook group for host families |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |page = 4 |date = 9 September 2015 }}</ref> It grew to 800 members and became the center of coordinating volunteer work to aid refugees in the city.<ref name="nd2"/><ref name="ew1"/> On 30 September, a group of refugees stayed a week in an Amersfoort sports hall. They moved to an empty school building before being relocated on 11 November to an emergency shelter in [[Soesterberg]].<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nd.nl/nieuws/nederland/604558/vluchteling-vertrekt-vrijwilliger-blijft-achter |website = Nederlands Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 29 March 2023 |last = Van Eijsden |first = Auke |title = Vluchteling vertrekt, vrijwilliger blijft achter |trans-title = Refugee leaves, volunteer stays behind |date = 28 December 2015 }}</ref> She criticized the Central Agency for the Reception of Asylum Seekers (COA), saying that refugees were only given basic necessities. According to Kennedy, not providing refugees with language courses, activities, or a purpose destroyed them mentally.<ref name="ew1">{{Cite magazine |magazine = [[Elsevier Weekblad]] |language = nl |url-access = subscription |access-date = 29 March 2023 |url = https://www.ewmagazine.nl/nederland/article/2016/02/hart-amersfoort-krijg-goed-gevoel-helpen-2757602W/ |title = Het hart van Amersfoort: 'Ik krijg een goed gevoel van helpen' |date = 5 February 2016 |last = Van den Bovenkamp |first = Niels |trans-title = The heart of Amersfoort: 'I feel good when I'm helping' }}</ref> Furthermore, she told that the move to Soesterberg challenged volunteers to enter in.<ref name="ad4">{{Cite interview |last = Kennedy |first = Simone |title = 'Ieder mens heeft recht op een beetje warmte' |trans-title = 'Every human is entitled to a little bit of warmth' |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |date = 13 February 2016 |pages = 6–7 |interviewer = Marco Willemse }}</ref>

Kennedy announced in May 2016 that she would cease volunteering for refugees, as she could no longer handle it. She believed that all asylum seekers in Soesterberg were depressed, and she encouraged others to take on the work.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.ad.nl/amersfoort/het-gaat-niet-goed-in-azc-zeist~a520e3fa/ |website = Algemeen Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 30 March 2023 |date = 12 May 2016 |last = Van Kommer |first = Rachel |title = 'Het gaat niet goed in azc Zeist' |trans-title = 'It is not going well in the Zeist asylum seekers' center' }}</ref> Kennedy did continue some activities, connecting refugees with people willing to have them stay in their empty home during the summer holiday.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/vluchteling-in-huis-voor-kat-en-plant~baa24d56/ |last = Salm |first = Harriët |language = nl |access-date = 3 April 2023 |date = 22 August 2016 |url-access = subscription |title = Vluchteling in huis voor kat en plant |trans-title = Refugee in your home for cat and plant |website = Trouw }}</ref> Kennedy received significant media attention for her refugee work, including from national publications.<ref name="nd2"/><ref name="ew1"/><ref name="ad4"/><ref>{{Cite news |website = Trouw |url-access = subscription |access-date = 30 March 2023 |language = nl |url = https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/hartekreet-vrijwilligster-leg-contact~b92a6a19/ |date = 1 June 2015 |last = Salm |first = Harriët |title = Hartekreet vrijwilligster: Leg contact! |trans-title = Cry from the heart by volunteer: Connect! }}</ref>

=== Final term ===
Kennedy sought a fourth term in the council of the [[2018 Dutch municipal elections|March 2018 municipal elections]] as the Christian Union's lead candidate.<ref name="ad5">{{Cite news |url = https://www.ad.nl/amersfoort/simone-kennedy-opnieuw-aanvoerder-lijst-christenunie~a1488003/ |website = Algemeen Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 3 April 2023 |date = 5 October 2017 |last = Kreekel |first = Artwin |title = Simone Kennedy opnieuw aanvoerder lijst ChristenUnie |trans-title = Simone Kennedy again Christian Union's lead candidate }}</ref> The party lost one of its five seats, while it had – in contrast to previous election cycles – competition from the [[Reformed Political Party]] (SGP).<ref name="dv5"/><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.rtvutrecht.nl/nieuws/1704496/sgp-probeert-het-in-maart-op-eigen-kracht-in-amersfoort |website = RTV Utrecht |language = nl |access-date = 3 April 2023 |date = 19 December 2017 |title = SGP probeert het in maart op eigen kracht in Amersfoort |trans-title = SGP will try on its own in Amersfoort in March }}</ref> Kennedy did not renominate herself as the council's vice chair after this election.<ref name="ad6"/> In May 2019, she announced that she would not run for re-election, citing term limits imposed by the party.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.ad.nl/amersfoort/simone-kennedy-stopt-als-raadslid-in-amersfoort~a3795e40/ |website = Algemeen Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 3 April 2023 |date = 21 May 2019 |last = Kreekel |first = Artwin |title = Simone Kennedy stopt als raadslid in Amersfoort |trans-title = Simone Kennedy leaves the Amersfoort council }}</ref> She already stepped down as parliamentary leader as of the start of the following year in order to focus on her career and on the national election campaign, being succeeded by Hans Bol.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.ad.nl/amersfoort/kennedy-zwaait-na-tien-jaar-af-als-fractievoorzitter-van-de-christenunie-in-amersfoort~a37db9aa/ |website = Algemeen Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 3 April 2023 |last = Schouten-Van den Boom |first = Iris |title = Kennedy zwaait na tien jaar af als fractievoorzitter van de ChristenUnie in Amersfoort |trans-title = Kennedy is stepping down after ten years as parliamentary leader of the Christian Union in Amersfoort |date = 18 December 2019 }}</ref> Her final term ended on 29 March 2022 following [[2022 Dutch municipal elections|municipal elections earlier that month]].<ref>{{Cite web |url = https://amersfoort.notubiz.nl/bijeenkomst/931704/De%20Raad%3A%20raadsvergadering%20Het%20Besluit%2029-03-2022 |website = De Raad van Amersfoort |language = nl |access-date = 4 April 2023 |title = De Raad: raadsvergadering Het Besluit |trans-title = The council: Council meeting ''Het Besluit'' }}</ref> On her last day in the council, the municipality awarded Kennedy the Sint-Jorispenning – a medal given to people who have significantly contributed to the city.<ref name="stad">{{Cite news |url = https://www.destadamersfoort.nl/lokaal/mensen/806072/onderscheidingen-voor-vertrekkende-raadsleden-hunink-kennedy-do |website = DeStadAmersfoort.nl |language = nl |access-date = 5 April 2023 |date = 30 March 2022 |title = Onderscheidingen voor vertrekkende raadsleden Hunink, Kennedy-Doornbos en Dijksterhuis |trans-title = Decorations for outgoing councilors Hunink, Kennedy-Doornbos, and Dijksterhuis }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.amersfoort.nl/gemeentelijke-onderscheidingen#sint-jorispenning-2222 |website = Amersfoort |language = nl |access-date = 5 April 2023 |title = Gemeentelijke onderscheidingen |trans-title = Municipal decorations }}</ref> She had earlier become a member of the [[Order of Orange-Nassau]] in April 2017.<ref>{{Cite news |title = Lintjesregen 2017 |trans-title = 2017 decorations |pages = 10–11 |date = 27 April 2017 |language = nl |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant }}</ref> She received those honors for her career in local politics as well as for her volunteering and refugee work. Kennedy volunteered at De Kandelaar, a Reformed church; at the Amersfoort [[food bank]]; at Stadsring 51, a local credit counseling foundation; and at CJVV, a local football club. She also co-founded the Amersfoort [[deacon|diaconal]] charity fund in 2013.<ref name="stad"/><ref>{{Cite web |url = https://www.noodfonds-amersfoort.nl |website = Stichting Kerkelijk Noodfonds Amersfoort |title = Home |language = nl |access-date = 5 April 2023 }}</ref>

After her exit form local politics, Kennedy became a youth care worker for [[The Salvation Army]], and she coordinated the sheltering of Ukrainian refugees following the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine]] as a location manager for the municipality. She fulfilled the latter role until November 2022.<ref name="ek1"/><ref>{{Cite news |title = Simone Kennedy senator CU |trans-title = Simone Kennedy CU senator |language = nl |newspaper = Trouw |date = 17 January 2023 |page = 2 }}</ref>

== National and provincial politics ==
=== Permanent campaign and think tank ===
Upon her return to the Netherlands in 2003, Kennedy joined the Christian Union's permanent campaign and the party's women's working group called Inclusief as well as the [[board of trustees]] of its [[think tank]].<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.christenunie.nl/kandidaten2006 |website = Christian Union |language = nl |access-date = 9 April 2023 |title = Tweede Kamer 2006-2010 |trans-title = House of Representatives 2006–2010 }}</ref> She chaired a Christian Union working group on public art. Together with [[Arie Slob]] – a former House member – Kennedy argued that public spaces should not be used to showcase innovative and experimental art, calling such works incomprehensible to the general population. She then proposed to have more public art that reflects the ideology and history of the city itself. For her hometown of Amersfoort, she suggested erecting statues of statesman [[Johan van Oldenbarnevelt]] (1547–1619) and painter [[Piet Mondrian]] (1872–1944), both born in the city.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2004/11/27/innovatieve-kunst-hoort-in-museum-niet-op-plein-7712507-a1234839 |website = NRC |url-access = subscription |access-date = 9 April 2023 |date = 27 November 2004 |title = Innovatieve kunst hoort in museum, niet op plein |language = nl |trans-title = Innovative art belongs in museum, not on square |last1 = Slob |first1 = Arie |authorlink = Arie Slob |last2 = Kennedy-Doornbos |first2 = Simone }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title = Beelden van bekende stedelingen |trans-title = Statues of well-known citizens |date = 20 October 2004 |newspaper = Utrechts Nieuwsblad |page = AS1 |language = nl }}</ref> Kennedy also wrote an opinion piece for ''[[de Volkskrant]]'' in that period, in which she criticized childcare benefits introduced by the 2004 Childcare Act. According to Kennedy, the government was financially punishing stay-at-home parents and subsidizing double-income families. She recommended a four-year benefit to be received by all parents to maximize freedom of choice.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.volkskrant.nl/economie/kind-belangrijker-dan-economie~bf5d0cbb/ |website = de Volkskrant |language = nl |url-access = subscription |access-date = 9 April 2023 |date = 13 October 2005 |title = Kind belangrijker dan economie |trans-title = Child more important than economy |last = Kennedy-Doornbos |first = Simone }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url = https://www.eerstekamer.nl/wetsvoorstel/28447_wet_kinderopvang |website = Senate |language = nl |access-date = 9 April 2023 |title = Wet kinderopvang |trans-title = Childcare Act }}</ref>

As part of the permanent campaign, Kennedy helped write the Christian Union's [[election program]] for general elections in [[2006 Dutch general election|2006]], [[2010 Dutch general election|2010]], and [[2012 Dutch general election|2012]].<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nrc.nl/nieuws/2009/08/24/invloedrijke-doordrammer-haalt-overal-zijn-gelijk-11772493-a544558 |website = NRC |language = nl |access-date = 9 April 2023 |url-access = subscription |date = 24 August 2009 |title = Invloedrijke doordrammer haalt overal zijn gelijk |trans-title = Influential nagger always gets his way |last = Walters |first = Derk }}</ref><ref>{{Cite report |url = https://www.christenunie.nl/l/library/download/urn:uuid:7ab581e7-0218-4c5b-a451-29a6cd9b6839/christenunie+verkiezingsprogramma+tweede+kamer+2010.pdf |publisher = Christian Union |language = nl |access-date = 9 April 2023 |page = 5 |title = Vooruitzien: Christelijk-sociaal perspectief |trans-title = Looking ahead: Christian-social perspective }}</ref><ref>{{Cite report |url = https://www.christenunie.nl/l/library/download/10136013/printversie+verkiezingsprogramma+christenunie+2013-2017.pdf |page = 2 |access-date = 9 April 2023 |title = Voor de verandering |trans-title = In support of the change |publisher = Christian Union |language = nl }}</ref> During those elections, she also occupied places 12, 13, and 39 on the [[party list]], respectively.<ref name="kies1"/><ref name="kies2"/><ref name="kies3"/> She ran for the [[Senate (Netherlands)|Senate]] [[2011 Dutch Senate election|in May 2011]] as the party's third candidate whilst mentioning the importance of personal responsibility. Kennedy was not elected due to the Christian Union losing two of its four Senate seats.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.rd.nl/artikel/388992-christenunie-teleurgesteld-na-halvering-zetelaantal |website = Reformatorisch Dagblad |language = nl |url-access = subscription |access-date = 13 April 2023 |date = 3 March 2011 |title = ChristenUnie teleurgesteld na halvering zetelaantal |trans-title = Christian Union disappointed after losing half its seats |last = Leeflang |first = Johan }}</ref><ref name="ek2"/><ref name="ter">{{Cite magazine |magazine = Terdege |access-date = 14 April 2023 |language = nl |via = Digibron |date = 2 March 2011 |title = Een onafhankelijke politica |trans-title = An independent politician |last = De Vries |first = Huib |pages = 18–22 |url = https://www.digibron.nl/viewer/collectie/Digibron/id/tag:Terdege,20110302:newsml_147d0986a154580af835269f323abe70 }}</ref> Kennedy co-authored a 2009 publication by Christian Union's think tank that called for a raise of the retirement age – contrary to the party's official position – to relieve younger families. The measure would generate additional tax income to prepare for upcoming costs. Kennedy stated that parents would not have to be pushed to work more and would therefore have enough time to spend with their families as well as participating in volunteering.<ref>{{Cite news |newspaper = Nederlands Dagblad |last = Sloot |first = Eduard |language = nl |title = Nieuw CU-denktank wil hogere AOW-leeftijd |trans-title = New CU think tank wants to raise the retirement age |page = 9 |date = 12 February 2009 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/rouvoet-crisis-te-lijf-met-beperken-aftrek-hypotheekrente~bb409e0c/ |website = Het Parool |language = nl |access-date = 13 April 2023 |date = 12 February 2009 |title = Rouvoet: Crisis te lijf met beperken aftrek hypotheekrente |trans-title = Rouvoet: Attack the crisis through limiting the mortgage interest deduction }}</ref> In 2012, during the [[European debt crisis]], the Christian Union joined the VVD, the CDA, GroenLinks, and D66 in support of a budget that raised the retirement age from 65 to 67 years after the [[first Rutte cabinet]] had fallen.<ref>{{Cite news |website = Het Parool |language = nl |access-date = 13 April 2023 |url = https://www.parool.nl/nieuws/vijf-partijen-bezuinigen-netto-12-4-miljard~b6e0ad97/ |date = 25 May 2012 |title = Vijf partijen bezuinigen netto 12,4 miljard |trans-title = Five parties reduce a net 12.4 billion in spending }}</ref>

Kennedy never ran for a Senate seat in the [[2015 Dutch Senate election|2015 election]], saying she wanted to remain a councilor in Amersfoort in order to deal with new responsibilities that were given to municipalities as part of a decentralization effort. She considered herself to be too much like an activist,<ref name="nd2"/> and announced her candidacy for the [[2017 Dutch general election|2017 general election]] as her children had become more independent. However, she was disappointed with her 22nd spot on the Christian Union's party list.<ref name="ad7">{{Cite news |newspaper = AD Amersfoortse Courant |language = nl |title = Vertrek uit raad nabij |trans-title = Departure from council nearing |page = 2 |date = 13 June 2016 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.rtvutrecht.nl/nieuws/1539755/amersfoortse-politica-baalt-van-lage-plek-tweede-kamer |website = RTV Utrecht |language = nl |access-date = 14 April 2023 |date = 19 October 2016 |title = Amersfoortse politica baalt van lage plek Tweede Kamer |trans-title = Amersfoort politician disappointed by low spot for House of Representatives }}</ref> After the Christian Union joined the new [[governing coalition]], Kennedy found the coalition agreement's statement on immigration too negative towards refugees, and she called on her party to execute it as leniently as possible.<ref>{{Cite news |title = Leden CU willen verruiming van asielafspraken |language = nl |newspaper = Nederlands Dagblad |date = 22 November 2017 |last = Mouissie |first = Sjoerd |page = 1 |trans-title = CU members want asylum agreements to be broadened }}</ref><ref>{{Cite episode |url = https://www.nporadio1.nl/fragmenten/dit-is-de-dag/a2a97874-a827-4073-90a6-d8481e7f4ec0/2017-11-22-leden-christenunie-eisen-ruimer-kinderpardon |access-date = 15 April 2023 |title = Leden ChristenUnie eisen ruimer kinderpardon |trans-title = Christian Union members demand broader pardon for children |language = nl |date = 22 November 2017 |series = Dit is de Dag |network = [[NPO Radio 1]] }}</ref>

Having assisted previous campaigns, she first participated in an election for the [[European Parliament]] [[2019 European Parliament election in the Netherlands|in 2019]] as the eighth candidate on the shared list [[Christian Union – Reformed Political Party]] (CU-SGP). Kennedy was not elected as the party won two seats, but she did receive 6,776 [[preference votes]] – more than any other candidate on the CU-SGP list after the third spot.<ref name="ad7"/><ref>{{Cite news |url-access = subscription |access-date = 14 April 2023 |language = nl |url = https://www.rd.nl/artikel/802129-veel-voorkeurstemmen-voor-anja-haga-cu- |date = 5 June 2019 |website = Reformatorisch Dagblad |title = Veel voorkeurstemmen voor Anja Haga (CU) |trans-title = Many preference votes for Anja Haga (CU) }}</ref> Kennedy previously criticized the Christian Union's 2009 decision to end its cooperation in the European Parliament with the [[Reformed Political Party]] (SGP). Her party had joined the [[European Conservatives and Reformists Party|European Conservatives and Reformists]] (ECR), while the SGP had been barred from entering the political group by the British [[Conservative Party (UK)|Conservative Party]] due to the SGP's internal ban on women holding political offices. Kennedy wrote that she had cooperated well with the SGP and that the Conservative Party was exhibiting the same intolerance it was accusing the SGP of by not allowing the SGP to join.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.digibron.nl/viewer/collectie/Digibron/id/tag:RD.nl,20090702:newsml_08f83448a633a0b4366986fae9c6de3a |via = Digibron |date = 2 July 2009 |title = CU had SGP niet mogen loslaten |trans-title = CU should not have let SGP go |page = 5 |newspaper = Reformatorisch Dagblad |access-date = 13 April 2023 |language = nl }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.trouw.nl/nieuws/breuk-in-europese-alliantie-sgp-en-cu~ba6e01ce/ |website = Trouw |language = nl |access-date = 13 April 2023 |date = 22 June 2009 |title = Breuk in Europese alliantie SGP en CU |trans-title = End of European alliance SGP and CU }}</ref> The SGP was eventually allowed in the ECR in 2014.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.nd.nl/nieuws/politiek/570601/een-europees-blok-cu-en-sgp |website = Nederlands Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 14 April 2023 |last = Beverdam |first = Gerard |title = Eén Europees blok CU en SGP |trans-title = One European CU and SGP block |date = 8 May 2018 }}</ref>

=== Senate and Provincial Council of Utrecht ===
[[File:Provinciehuis Utrecht zijaanzicht.jpg|thumb|alt=A tall white office building with a blue sky in the background|Seat of the [[Provincial Council of Utrecht]]]]
Kennedy was the Christian Union's sixth candidate in the [[2019 Dutch Senate election|May 2019 Senate election]], her party receiving four seats.<ref>{{Cite news |website = Nederlands Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 15 April 2023 |url = https://www.nd.nl/nieuws/politiek/546418/tineke-huizinga-op-cu-lijst-eerste-kamer |title = Tineke Huizinga op CU-lijst Eerste Kamer |date = 29 October 2018 |last = Sloot |first = Eduard |trans-title = Tineke Huizinga on CU list Senate }}</ref><ref name="kies4"/> Following the death of Christian Union Senator [[Peter Ester]] on 11 December 2022, Kennedy was appointed as his successor due to her position on the party list during the last election. She was sworn into the Senate on 17 January 2023. Kennedy said that she would focus on helping vulnerable people in society, having a fair distribution of the tax burden, and preventing the government from interfering in the responsibilities of individuals and organizations.<ref>{{Cite news |url = https://www.ad.nl/amersfoort/amersfoorts-christenunie-boegbeeld-simone-kennedy-naar-eerste-kamer-als-opvolger-overleden-peter-ester~a6160217/ |website = Algemeen Dagblad |language = nl |access-date = 15 April 2023 |last = Hardeman |first = Johan |title = Amersfoorts ChristenUnie-boegbeeld Simone Kennedy naar Eerste Kamer als opvolger overleden Peter Ester |trans-title = Amersfoort Christian Union figurehead Simone Kennedy to the Senate as successor of late Peter Ester |date = 12 January 2023 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite press release |url = https://www.eerstekamer.nl/nieuws/20230117/kennedy_doornbos_christenunie |website = Senate |language = nl |access-date = 15 April 2023 |date = 17 January 2023 |title = Kennedy-Doornbos (ChristenUnie) geïnstalleerd als Eerste Kamerlid |trans-title = Kennedy-Doornbos (Christian Union) sworn in as senator }}</ref>

She was elected to the [[Provincial Council of Utrecht]] [[2023 Dutch provincial elections|in March 2023]] when the Christian Union won three seats and Kennedy had been placed third on the party list, and she was installed on 29 March.<ref name="kies5"/><ref>{{Cite press release |url = https://www.provincie-utrecht.nl/actueel/nieuws/nieuwe-provinciale-staten-2023-2027-aan-de-slag |website = [[Province of Utrecht]] |language = nl |access-date = 15 April 2023 |date = 30 March 2023 |title = Nieuwe Provinciale Staten (2023-2027) aan de slag |trans-title = New provincial council (2023–2027) to work }}</ref> Her Senate term came to an end after five months on 12 June 2023, as she had not run for [[2023 Dutch Senate elections|re-election in May]].<ref>{{Cite web |url = https://www.eerstekamer.nl/persoon/drs_s_j_kennedy_doornbos |website = [[Senate (Netherlands)|Senate]] |language = nl |access-date = 12 August 2023 |title = Drs. S.J. Kennedy-Doornbos (ChristenUnie) }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url = https://www.kiesraad.nl/adviezen-en-publicaties/proces-verbalen/2023/6/1/proces-verbaal-uitslag-eerste-kamerverkiezing-2023 |website = Dutch Electoral Council |title = Proces-verbaal uitslag Eerste Kamerverkiezing 2023 |trans-title = Records of the results of the 2023 Senate election |date = 1 June 2023 |language = nl |access-date = 12 August 2023 |format = PDF |pages = 48–50 }}</ref>

==== Senate committee assignments ====
* Committee on Finances
* Committee on Kingdom Relations
* Committee on Social Affairs and Employment<ref>{{Cite web |url = https://www.eerstekamer.nl/commissies?lid=vlzig475vip3 |access-date = 15 April 2023 |language = nl |website = Senate |title = Lidmaatschappen S.J. Kennedy-Doornbos |trans-title = Memberships S.J. Kennedy-Doornbos }}</ref>
